source.subject: The Golden Ticket #89: Events to book right now
source.label: Golden Ticket #89

events.title: Mrs H Festive & the Sing-along Band Festive Celebration
events.blurb: A live six-piece band plays festive music for families, with singing and silly dances.

events.title: Family Film Club x LIAF: Amazing Animations for 0-7 year olds
events.blurb: A selection of animated shorts with talking animals and cheeky adventures for little ones.

events.title: Saturday Sessions: A Festive Cracker
events.blurb: Len Blanco leads free festive games, dances and crafts for families.

events.title: Ballroom Boogie x Toasty Tots XL
events.blurb: A free family dance party for 5–11s and their grown-ups after Saturday Sessions.

events.title: Family Film Club: Marcel Father Christmas and the Pizza Delivery Boy
events.blurb: A zany Parisian animation about a pizza boy who helps Father Christmas deliver presents.

events.title: Family Film Club: Forgotten Island
events.blurb: Two best friends find a portal to a mythical Filipino island in this action-comedy animation.

events.title: SideWays: A Sensory Playscape
events.when: 23 January 2027 to 6 June 2027, various slots throughout each day
events.blurb: A tactile, tipped-sideways play installation from sensory theatre pioneers Oily Cart.

events.title: Matisse: Joy
events.when: 27 January 2027 to 8 May 2027, various timeslots throughout the day
events.blurb: Matisse's art projected across four giant walls, with new work by Yinka Ilori.

events.title: Family Film Club: Kensuke's Kingdom
events.blurb: Animated adaptation of Michael Morpurgo's tale of a boy shipwrecked on a mysterious island.
